_comment: Credential store for the MT5 bridge. Copy to accounts.json and fill in.
accounts.json is gitignored and must never be committed (spec §47).
Keys are credential_ref values, matching trading_accounts.credential_ref
in Postgres. The database stores the ref; only this file holds a secret,
and only the bridge process reads it.
Use an INVESTOR (read-only) password. The bridge refuses an account whose
account_info reports trade_allowed=true unless allow_master is set.
